name: IMS for Quantum13
description: An Integrated Management System for Quantum13, a network solutions company. It replaces internal Excel-based workflows with role-based access control, project management tools, live client dashboards, and data visualization.

name: Seccotruco.com
description: A website that teaches how to play Truco, a popular Brazilian card game. I built it to help my friends learn the rules and strategies.

name: MSL Manager
description: A desktop password manager for macOS that uses cryptography to securely store passwords. Built while learning Firebase for backend integration.

name: Python Manager
description: A desktop password manager with a GUI built using Python and Tkinter. Developed as my first password manager for an Operating Systems class project.

name: Mavaquatics
description: A centralized platform for swimmers, coaches, and parents to interact and collaborate. Features role-based access control and was developed as a semester-long Software Engineering project.
